_comment: THE CHRONICLE AND THE TELEMETRY PAGE (DECISIONS #276). tools/telemetry/chronicle.py, on the machine that hosts, is subscribed to the game's database as its owner and writes every change of every table to build/telemetry/<database>.sqlite, forever (keep_days 0) or for keep_days days. skip: tables it does not subscribe to at all (every step, every tick: too many to keep, and nothing worth looking back at). quiet: per table, columns whose change alone is not worth a line (a heartbeat). Scheduled tables are always skipped. Everyone's place comes from where_sample, every foundation.telemetry_where_s seconds (a hot rule). panels: what tools\telemetry.cmd shows; each is SQL over the chronicle's file (its tables: change, position, player_name, run), with :since, :now, :bucket (seconds, from the range picked), :cell (metres, a heatmap's square) and :player (0: everyone). kind: line (t, series, value), bar (label, value), table (any columns), heatmap (level, x, z, value). A genre adds its own skip, quiet and panels in shared/<genre>/telemetry.json.

panels.title: Players online
panels.sql: SELECT CAST(p.at / :bucket AS INTEGER) * :bucket AS t, 'online' AS series, COUNT(DISTINCT p.entity_id) AS value FROM position p JOIN player_name n ON n.entity_id = p.entity_id AND n.tool = 0 WHERE p.at >= :since GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Where players were
panels.sql: SELECT p.level, CAST(p.x / :cell AS INTEGER) * :cell AS x, CAST(p.z / :cell AS INTEGER) * :cell AS z, COUNT(*) AS value FROM position p JOIN player_name n ON n.entity_id = p.entity_id AND n.tool = 0 WHERE p.at >= :since AND (:player = 0 OR p.entity_id = :player) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

panels.title: Who played
panels.sql: SELECT n.name AS player, datetime(MIN(p.at), 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS first_seen, datetime(MAX(p.at), 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS last_seen, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(p.at / 60 AS INTEGER)) AS minutes FROM position p JOIN player_name n ON n.entity_id = p.entity_id AND n.tool = 0 WHERE p.at >= :since GROUP BY p.entity_id ORDER BY MAX(p.at) DESC

panels.title: Frame rate (players' reports)
panels.sql: SELECT CAST(c.at / :bucket AS INTEGER) * :bucket AS t, COALESCE(n.name, 'referee') AS series, ROUND(AVG(json_extract(c.row, '$.fps')), 1) AS value FROM change c LEFT JOIN player_name n ON n.entity_id = json_extract(c.row, '$.entity_id') WHERE c.tbl = 'perf_report' AND c.op = 'insert' AND c.at >= :since AND (:player = 0 OR json_extract(c.row, '$.entity_id') = :player) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Ping (players' reports)
panels.sql: SELECT CAST(c.at / :bucket AS INTEGER) * :bucket AS t, COALESCE(n.name, 'referee') AS series, ROUND(AVG(json_extract(c.row, '$.rtt_ms')), 1) AS value FROM change c LEFT JOIN player_name n ON n.entity_id = json_extract(c.row, '$.entity_id') WHERE c.tbl = 'perf_report' AND c.op = 'insert' AND c.at >= :since AND json_extract(c.row, '$.role') = 0 AND (:player = 0 OR json_extract(c.row, '$.entity_id') = :player) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Chat
panels.sql: SELECT datetime(c.at, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS at, json_extract(c.row, '$.name') AS player, json_extract(c.row, '$.text') AS said FROM change c WHERE c.tbl = 'chat_message' AND c.op = 'insert' AND c.at >= :since AND (:player = 0 OR json_extract(c.row, '$.entity_id') = :player) ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Feedback (F8)
panels.sql: SELECT datetime(c.at, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS at, json_extract(c.row, '$.name') AS player, CASE json_extract(c.row, '$.category') WHEN 0 THEN 'Bug' WHEN 1 THEN 'Lag' WHEN 2 THEN 'Idea' ELSE 'Other' END AS about, json_extract(c.row, '$.text') AS said FROM change c WHERE c.tbl = 'feedback' AND c.op = 'insert' AND c.at >= :since AND (:player = 0 OR json_extract(c.row, '$.entity_id') = :player) ORDER BY c.at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: What the chronicle kept (lines per table)
panels.sql: SELECT tbl AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM change WHERE at >= :since AND op != 'have' GROUP BY tbl ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 25
